verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs show event-driven building blocks—CEL-based event filters, cron triggers, and concurrency-key rules (hatchet-docs-10, hatchet-docs-16, hatchet-docs-5/6/18)—and its GitHub description positions it as an orchestration platform for tasks/workflows/agents (hatchet-gh-1/2), which aligns with automatically triggering actions on events. However, there's no detailed first-party walkthrough of defining a full event-trigger rule (e.g., webhook/event payload → workflow start) nor independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific mechanic. Missing for 10: a concrete example of an event-trigger rule definition, and independent/community verification that event-triggered automation works as documented.
